prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache. Over four visits, the treating provider documented cervical pain with restricted range of motion and muscle guarding consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism. The mechanism of injury described is a plausible cause of the symptoms observed. Cervical imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none is known from the available records. Treatment followed a course somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury, though progress was steady and the plan was adjusted as symptoms improved. Billing records reflect the services rendered, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. Plan going forward includes home stretching, activity modification, and a reassessment of range of motion at follow-up.
